SELECT
  FISCAL_CALENDAR.FISCAL_YEAR,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM FISCAL_CALENDAR.PERIOD_START),
  SUM(CASE WHEN GL_ENTRIES.ACCOUNT_NUMBER BETWEEN 5000 AND 5999 THEN GL_ENTRIES.AMOUNT END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN GL_ENTRIES.ACCOUNT_NUMBER BETWEEN 4000 AND 4999 THEN GL_ENTRIES.AMOUNT END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN GL_ENTRIES.ACCOUNT_NUMBER BETWEEN 5000 AND 5999 THEN GL_ENTRIES.AMOUNT END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN GL_ENTRIES.ACCOUNT_NUMBER BETWEEN 4000 AND 4999 THEN GL_ENTRIES.AMOUNT END),0)
FROM
  CNR_FIN.FISCAL_CALENDAR  FISCAL_CALENDAR,
  CNR_FIN.GL_ENTRIES  GL_ENTRIES
WHERE
  ( GL_ENTRIES.PERIOD_START=FISCAL_CALENDAR.PERIOD_START  )
  AND  ( FISCAL_CALENDAR.PERIOD_START < TO_DATE('2025-12-01','YYYY-MM-DD') )
GROUP BY
  FISCAL_CALENDAR.FISCAL_YEAR,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM FISCAL_CALENDAR.PERIOD_START)

SELECT
  FISCAL_CALENDAR.FISCAL_YEAR,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM FISCAL_CALENDAR.PERIOD_START),
  SUM(FREIGHT_REVENUE.TOTAL_REVENUE)
FROM
  CNR_FIN.FISCAL_CALENDAR  FISCAL_CALENDAR,
  CNR_FIN.FREIGHT_REVENUE  FREIGHT_REVENUE
WHERE
  ( FREIGHT_REVENUE.PERIOD_START=FISCAL_CALENDAR.PERIOD_START  )
  AND  ( FISCAL_CALENDAR.PERIOD_START < TO_DATE('2025-12-01','YYYY-MM-DD') )
GROUP BY
  FISCAL_CALENDAR.FISCAL_YEAR,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM FISCAL_CALENDAR.PERIOD_START)
